content.text:
The drawing shows a benzene ring with three adjacent substituents:

- A methyl ester (CO2Me) on one ring carbon.
- An acetamido group (NHC(=O)CH3) on the next carbon.
- A nitro group (NO2) on the carbon after that.

The ring is therefore 1,2,3-trisubstituted, with the acetamido group in the middle. The molecule is methyl 2-acetamido-3-nitrobenzoate.

SMILES: COC(=O)c1cccc([N+](=O)[O-])c1NC(C)=O
